properties.name: template
properties.label: Template

properties.name: target
properties.label: Target
properties.helpText: Destination field for the mapper. LOCAL (default) means that the changes are applied to the username stored in local database upon user import. BROKER_ID and BROKER_USERNAME means that the changes are stored into the ID or username used for federation user lookup, respectively.

saml-advanced-role-idp-mapper.name: Advanced Attribute to Role
saml-advanced-role-idp-mapper.helpText: If the set of attributes exists and can be matched, grant the user the specified realm or client role.

properties.name: attributes
properties.label: Attributes
properties.helpText: Name and (regex) value of the attributes to search for in token.  The configured name of an attribute is searched in SAML attribute name and attribute friendly name fields. Every given attribute description must be met to set the role. If the attribute is an array, then the value must be contained in the array. If an attribute can be found several times, then one match is sufficient.

properties.name: are.attribute.values.regex
properties.label: Regex Attribute Values
properties.helpText: If enabled attribute values are interpreted as regular expressions.

properties.name: role
properties.label: Role
properties.helpText: Role to grant to user if all attributes are present. Click 'Select Role' button to browse roles, or just type it in the textbox. To reference a client role the syntax is clientname.clientrole, i.e. myclient.myrole

saml-xpath-attribute-idp-mapper.name: XPath Attribute Importer
saml-xpath-attribute-idp-mapper.helpText: Extract text of a saml attribute via XPath expression and import into the specified user property or attribute.

properties.name: attribute.xpath
properties.label: Attribute XPath
properties.helpText: XPath expression to search for. All attributes are surrounded with a <root> element. Given prefixes and namespaces are preserved. Example: <root><myPrefix:Person xmlns:myPrefix="http://my.namespace/schema"><myPrefix:FirstName>John</myPrefix:FirstName>...</myPrefix:Person></root> or <root>Some attribute value of anyType</root>

properties.name: attribute.name
properties.label: Attribute Name
properties.helpText: Name of attribute to search for in assertion and apply XPath. You can leave this blank to try to apply XPath to all attributes or specify a friendly name instead.

properties.name: attribute.friendly.name
properties.label: Friendly Name
properties.helpText: Friendly name of attribute to search for in assertion. You can leave this blank to try to apply XPath to all attributes or specify a name instead.

properties.name: user.attribute
properties.label: User Attribute Name
properties.helpText: User attribute name to store XPath value. Use email, firstName, and lastName for e-mail, first and last name, respectively.

hardcoded-user-session-attribute-idp-map.name: Hardcoded User Session Attribute
hardcoded-user-session-attribute-idp-map.helpText: When user is imported from provider, hardcode a value to a specific user session attribute.

properties.name: attribute
properties.label: User Session Attribute
properties.helpText: Name of user session attribute you want to hardcode

properties.name: attribute.value
properties.label: User Session Attribute Value
properties.helpText: Value you want to hardcode

saml-user-attribute-idp-mapper.name: Attribute Importer
saml-user-attribute-idp-mapper.helpText: Import declared saml attribute if it exists in assertion into the specified user property or attribute.

properties.name: attribute.name
properties.label: Attribute Name
properties.helpText: Name of attribute to search for in assertion.  You can leave this blank and specify a friendly name instead.

properties.name: attribute.friendly.name
properties.label: Friendly Name
properties.helpText: Friendly name of attribute to search for in assertion.  You can leave this blank and specify a name instead.

properties.name: attribute.name.format
properties.label: Name Format
properties.helpText: Name format of attribute to specify in the RequestedAttribute element. Default to basic format.

properties.name: user.attribute
properties.label: User Attribute Name
properties.helpText: User attribute name to store saml attribute.  Use email, lastName, and firstName to map to those predefined user properties.

properties.name: allow.nullable.property
properties.label: Allow Nullable Property
properties.helpText: If true, the property will be set to null when the claim is empty.

oidc-hardcoded-role-idp-mapper.name: Hardcoded Role
oidc-hardcoded-role-idp-mapper.helpText: When user is imported from provider, hardcode a role mapping for it.

properties.name: role
properties.label: Role
properties.helpText: Role to grant to user.  Click 'Select Role' button to browse roles, or just type it in the textbox.  To reference a client role the syntax is clientname.clientrole, i.e. myclient.myrole

oidc-hardcoded-group-idp-mapper.name: Hardcoded Group
oidc-hardcoded-group-idp-mapper.helpText: Assign the user to the specified group.

properties.name: group
properties.label: Group
properties.helpText: Group to assign the user.

saml-advanced-group-idp-mapper.name: Advanced Attribute to Group
saml-advanced-group-idp-mapper.helpText: If all attributes exists, assign the user to the specified group.

properties.name: attributes
properties.label: Attributes
properties.helpText: Name and value of the attributes to search for in token. You can reference nested attributes using a '.', i.e. 'address.locality'. To use dot (.) literally, escape it with backslash (\.)

properties.name: are.attribute.values.regex
properties.label: Regex Attribute Values
properties.helpText: If enabled attribute values are interpreted as regular expressions.

properties.name: group
properties.label: Group
properties.helpText: Group to assign the user to if attribute is present.

hardcoded-attribute-idp-mapper.name: Hardcoded Attribute
hardcoded-attribute-idp-mapper.helpText: When user is imported from provider, hardcode a value to a specific user attribute.

properties.name: attribute
properties.label: User Attribute
properties.helpText: Name of user attribute you want to hardcode

properties.name: attribute.value
properties.label: User Attribute Value
properties.helpText: Value you want to hardcode

saml-role-idp-mapper.name: SAML Attribute to Role
saml-role-idp-mapper.helpText: If an attribute exists, grant the user the specified realm or client role.

properties.name: attribute.name
properties.label: Attribute Name
properties.helpText: Name of attribute to search for in assertion.  You can leave this blank and specify a friendly name instead.

properties.name: attribute.friendly.name
properties.label: Friendly Name
properties.helpText: Friendly name of attribute to search for in assertion.  You can leave this blank and specify a name instead.

properties.name: attribute.value
properties.label: Attribute Value
properties.helpText: Value the attribute must have.  If the attribute is a list, then the value must be contained in the list.

properties.name: role
properties.label: Role
properties.helpText: Role to grant to user.  Click 'Select Role' button to browse roles, or just type it in the textbox.  To reference a client role the syntax is clientname.clientrole, i.e. myclient.myrole
